newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan rescues 73 illegal Chinese seamen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan rescues 73 illegal Chinese seamen.

text.p: Taiwan coast guard ships have rescued 73 Chinese fishermen from a boat that crashed into rocks off the island's northeast coast, state television reported on Sunday.
It said more than 10 fishermen swam ashore on Saturday and asked rescue officials for help as their boat sank slowly in waters off Ilan country.
Taiwan authorities said they were not certain whether they had rescued all the fishermen from the boat.

"We are still trying to see if the number of people originally on the boat was the same as the 73 whom we rescued. If not, we have to continue the rescue work," Ilan police chief Lin Shih-tang said on state television.

They said the boat carrying illegal Chinese workers was anchored in high seas. Many Taiwanese-owned fishing boats hire mainland workers illegally and keep them on boats to circumvent local immigration authorities.
The boat that crashed on Saturday was forced to anchored off a remote coastline after authorities launched a crackdown in November, television said.
Taiwan does not let mainland Chinese seamen enter the island or work on boats within 12 nautical miles of the its coast.
